HMP_2019_ibdmdb: IBDMDB TreeSummarizedExperiment data

Source: R/miaViz.R
HMP_2019_ibdmdb.Rd

An example gut microbiome dataset derived from the curatedMetagenomicData HMP_2019_ibdmdb resource (iHMP/HMP2 IBD cohort; Lloyd-Price et al., 2019).

data(HMP_2019_ibdmdb)

Format

A TreeSummarizedExperiment with 585 microbial species (rows) and 44 stool samples (columns) from 22 subjects with inflammatory bowel disease (two time points per subject: baseline T0 and follow-up T1).

Assays include relative abundance (relabundance) and a scaled version of the same data (scaled). Taxonomic annotation is stored in rowData, and a phylogenetic tree is available via rowTree. Sample metadata (colData) includes subject identifiers, time point, IBD subtype (CD/UC), and additional technical and demographic variables.

Source

Derived from curatedMetagenomicData (Lloyd-Price et al., 2019).

Details

The object is provided as a TreeSummarizedExperiment.

References

Lloyd-Price J, Arze C, Ananthakrishnan AN, et al. (2019). Multi-omics of the gut microbial ecosystem in inflammatory bowel diseases. Nature 569, 655–662. doi:10.1038/s41586-019-1237-9

Examples

data("HMP_2019_ibdmdb", package = "miaViz")
HMP_2019_ibdmdb
#> class: TreeSummarizedExperiment 
#> dim: 585 44 
#> metadata(0):
#> assays(2): relabundance scaled
#> rownames(585): species:Phocaeicola vulgatus species:Bacteroides
#>   uniformis ... species:Enterococcus dispar species:Atopobium minutum
#> rowData names(7): superkingdom phylum ... genus species
#> colnames(44): CSM5FZ4E_P CSM5MCUQ_P ... PSM7J13I PSMA267H
#> colData names(27): study_name subject_id ... time_point treatment
#> reducedDimNames(0):
#> mainExpName: NULL
#> altExpNames(0):
#> rowLinks: a LinkDataFrame (585 rows)
#> rowTree: 1 phylo tree(s) (10430 leaves)
#> colLinks: NULL
#> colTree: NULL
SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(HMP_2019_ibdmdb)
#> [1] "relabundance" "scaled"      
TreeSummarizedExperiment::rowTree(HMP_2019_ibdmdb)
